scheme_name: Unemployment Allowance for the Educated Unemployed Youth Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a domicile of Haryana.

Applicant must have passed the 10+2 examination or hold a 2‑year certificate/diploma after Matric, or hold a Graduate degree or higher, or completed a 3‑year certificate/diploma after the 10+2 examination.
Applicant must be registered with any Employment Exchange in Haryana continuously for at least 3 years as of 1st November each year.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000.
Family must not own residential or commercial property exceeding ₹10 lakh in value.
Family must not own agricultural land exceeding 2 hectares.
Applicant must not be a student, trainee, or apprentice.
Applicant must not be employed or self‑employed.
Applicant must not be a dismissed government employee.
Applicant must not have been convicted of an offense resulting in imprisonment of six months or more.
Applicant must not be registered in the Saksham Yuva Scheme of the Employment Department.
For married female applicants, an in‑Laws ration card (joint or separate) is mandatory.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly unemployment allowance of ₹900 for 10+2 qualified youth and ₹1,500 for graduates or equivalent qualifications.
